name: manual_2349e2
claim: An agent type without a shell cannot read at exact SHAs: pre-materialize read-only exact-SHA trees and confirm each agent type's tools before fan-out, and cap fan-out because a large run lost most of its agents to a session limit.

decisions.notes: An 18-agent run lost 15 agents; Read/Grep-only agent types could not use git show.

rationale: An 18-agent run lost 15 agents; Read/Grep-only agent types could not use git show.
